                                                                                                                See the whole network

                                                                                                                GP

                                                                                                                Can assess ADHD and prescribe medication, depending on your state, then keep it reviewed.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: A diagnosis, medication, reviews
                                                                                                                • Sessions: A long first visit, then reviews
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed.

                                                                                                                Psychologist

                                                                                                                What each offers differs: some assess and diagnose, others focus on therapy, strategies or parenting support.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Assessment, therapy, strategies
                                                                                                                • Sessions: Usually 50-minute sessions
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed. A GP plan can get you a Medicare rebate.

                                                                                                                Psychiatrist

                                                                                                                A specialist doctor for complex or overlapping conditions and harder medication questions.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Complex care, medication, a second opinion
                                                                                                                • Sessions: A first consultation, then reviews
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: You need a GP referral, which also gets you the Medicare rebate.

                                                                                                                ADHD coach

                                                                                                                Practical help with routines, planning and getting things done. Most here are former teachers.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Routines, study, getting organised
                                                                                                                • Sessions: Weekly or fortnightly, often online
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed. Not covered by Medicare.

                                                                                                                Occupational therapist

                                                                                                                Routines and strategies for children and teens, built at home, at school or in the clinic.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Daily routines, school, sensory needs
                                                                                                                • Sessions: In the clinic, at home or at school
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed. The NDIS or private health may help with fees.

                                                                                                                Counsellor

                                                                                                                Counsellors and mental health social workers: someone to talk things through with.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Stress, relationships, life changes
                                                                                                                • Sessions: In person or online
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed. Some offer Medicare rebates with a GP plan.

                                                                                                                Physiotherapist

                                                                                                                Helps you recover from pain or injury and keep moving, at a pace that suits you.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Pain, injury, getting active
                                                                                                                • Sessions: Hands-on care and exercises
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed.

                                                                                                                Exercise physiologist

                                                                                                                Exercise built around you and what you enjoy, for focus, sleep and mood.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Movement, sleep, mood
                                                                                                                • Sessions: A program built for you
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed.

                                                                                                                Dietitian

                                                                                                                Practical help with food and nutrition, including eating disorders and restrictive eating.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Eating, nutrition, restrictive eating
                                                                                                                • Sessions: Online, wherever you are
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed. Private health or the NDIS may help with fees.

                                                                                                                Therapy assistant

                                                                                                                Practises skills with you between sessions, supervised by your psychologist.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Practising skills, routines, NDIS support
                                                                                                                • Sessions: Between your psychology sessions
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: Works alongside your psychologist. Often funded by the NDIS.

                                                                                                                Neurotherapy

                                                                                                                Brain mapping (QEEG) and neurotherapy sessions, in the clinic.

                                                                                                                • Helps with: Brain mapping, training sessions
                                                                                                                • Sessions: An assessment, then training sessions
                                                                                                                • Referral and cost: No referral needed. In person only.
